description: List, add or remove the document's custom style mappings, which map source styles to other styles when linked content is placed or updated with style mapping on (Link Options > Define Custom Style Mapping; Content Placer > Edit Custom Style Mapping)

action.description: add (or change) a mapping, remove one, or list them

destination.description: add: the style (or style group) it maps to

kind.description: add, remove: paragraph, character, table or cell styles

rule.description: add: map style to style, group to group, style to group, or group to style

source.description: add, remove: the source style (or style group) name

name: manage_style_mappings
title: Manage Style Mappings
